title: Nivolumab vs docetaxel in previously treated advanced squamous NSCLC (CheckMate 017)
indication: Squamous cell non-small cell lung cancer
primary_endpoint: Overall survival (OS) in all randomized participants
actual_notes: Primary OS endpoint met (investigator log-rank p=0.0002 on ClinicalTrials.gov results; nivolumab median OS 9.23 months vs docetaxel 6.01 months).
